subject: physics

hotspots.label: Engine
hotspots.description: The machine that burns input energy and splits it into useful work and waste heat.
hotspots.function: Performs the energy conversion whose ratio is efficiency.

hotspots.label: Fuel Slider
hotspots.description: Sets the total input energy; the two output bars split it.
hotspots.colorHint: A warm red slider at the left.
hotspots.function: Fixes the denominator of the efficiency formula.

hotspots.label: Useful-Output Bar
hotspots.description: The green bar for the useful work that actually came out.
hotspots.colorHint: Tall green bar on the output panel.
hotspots.function: Marks the numerator of the efficiency formula.

hotspots.label: Waste-Heat Bar
hotspots.description: The grey bar for input that escaped as heat, sound, or drag.
hotspots.colorHint: Short grey bar under the green one.
hotspots.function: Shows the loss that keeps efficiency below 100%.

hotspots.label: Efficiency Badge
hotspots.description: The percent readout = useful ÷ total × 100, always under 100.
hotspots.colorHint: A pale circular badge with a big number.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A compact engine with a red fuel slider, a green/grey output bar panel, and a circular percent badge.
materialNotes: Metallic=0, roughness ~0.5. Bars bright green/grey fill on pale panel, no emissive or bloom.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: efficiency = useful output ÷ total input.

GEOMETRY: engine block; a fuel slider; two output bars (green useful 1.2,1.3,0.1; grey waste 1.2,0.6,0.1); a percent badge (1.2,1.9,0.1).

INTERACTION: the fuel slider sets input energy; the useful bar = ~30% of input by default, heat bar = the rest; percent badge recomputes. A friction knob toggles losses lower, raising efficiency.

NAMED NODES: Engine, FuelSlider, UsefulBar, WasteBar, PercentBadge, FrictionKnob. 6-9k tris.
